purpose: prospective development factorial; no final seeds
orientation_condition: upstream_aligned_handoff_assumed; initial perturbations from fixed development manifest
grasp_condition: challenge_sc rigid attachment visually estimated; fixed known finger aperture
primary_endpoint: independent stable requested-target seat plus whole-trial penetration <=0.1 mm
failure_accounting: all selected cases including pre-motion perception rejections; setup failures separate and preserved
source_freeze: no policy changes during a matched batch; if changed, report a new version, never pool
